theorems.name: Submission.gwe_wewe_lipschitz_fderiv_facts
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ), LipschitzOnWith 1 f (closedBall 0 r) → Measurable (fun x => hsNormSq (fderiv ℝ f x)) ∧ (∀ j : Fin ℓ, Measurable (gradient (fun y => f y j))) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ hsNormSq (fderiv ℝ f x)) ∧ (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) r, hsNormSq (fderiv ℝ f x) ≤ n ∧ ∀ j : Fin ℓ, ‖gradient (fun y => f y j) x‖ ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (Rn n)), x ∈ ball 0 r → ∀ j : Fin ℓ, ‖gradient (fun y => f y j) x‖ ^ 2 ≤ hsNormSq (fderiv ℝ f x)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
